name: Morikawa Tomoko
source: Just like [url=/c7217]Mikkun[/url], Tomoko is part of a band led by [url=/c4014]Kotori[/url], where she plays the bass guitar. She is a faithful friend who is always ready to help her bandmates, Kotori and Mikkun. But sometimes she acts like an airhead.
